title: Read portable architecture snapshots offline
statement: The system shall let a reader inspect a complete generated architecture snapshot offline without the generation tools, original project checkout or operational database, while identifying the snapshot scope and its limits of currency.

what.problem: A shared page may depend on unavailable source files or network services.
what.desired_outcome: let a reader inspect a complete generated architecture snapshot offline without the generation tools, original project checkout or operational database, while identifying the snapshot scope and its limits of currency.

why.rationale: Customer use needs attributable, portable views and truthful boundaries beyond repository-local demonstration.

conditions: When generating, reading or qualifying the selected architecture browser capability.

contexts: One selected customer project/state and explicitly selected output; declared product generation and reading environments.

how.approach: Assess the stated observable outcomes against explicit supported profiles, selected source identity and actual artifacts; preserve ownership and diagnose unavailable or incomplete results.

how_much.scope: Read-only local generation and portable snapshot reading. No live editor, hosted-service requirement, cross-project aggregation, automatic publication or invented performance target. Detailed realization and platform support are downstream design decisions.

acceptance_criteria: Copy the complete output to another supported reading environment, make the source checkout unavailable and disable network access; required navigation, diagrams, definitions and included rationale remain usable.
The snapshot contains the reading resources and source detail needed to understand its selected scope; unavailable optional external links do not replace required explanations.
Reading requires no generator, rendering compiler, remote fonts or script CDN, hosted service or local operational database.
The reader can identify project/profile, input content identity and generator provenance; the snapshot does not claim live freshness without a fresh comparison.
Opening or copying the snapshot does not alter engineering sources or grant permission to publish customer information.

sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
